description: This file defines data classes and enums for representing events and rendezvous events in the torch distributed elastic framework, including serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: EventSource
classes.description: Enum for identifiers of event producers, such as AGENT and WORKER.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a generic event during torchelastic job execution, with serialization methods.

classes.name: NodeState
classes.description: Enum for possible states of a node in rendezvous process.

classes.name: RdzvEvent
classes.description: Represents a rendezvous event with details like name, run_id, message, hostname, pid, node_state, and optional fields.

methods.name: Event.deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or Event object into an Event instance.

methods.name: Event.serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Event instance into a JSON string.

methods.name: RdzvEvent.deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or RdzvEvent object into an RdzvEvent instance.

methods.name: RdzvEvent.serialize
methods.description: Serializes the RdzvEvent instance into a JSON string.
